title: CPH2583_15.0.0.305(EX01)
description:
New version:CPH2583_15.0.0.305(EX01)

A system update is available

Communication & interconnection

•Now you can easily share live photos with iOS devices nearby.

•Improves the stability and expands the compatibility of Bluetooth connections.

System

•Improves gaming experience by ensuring stable frame rates.

•Adds a Reply in floating window feature. You can turn it on or off in "Settings - Notifications & Quick Settings - Banners".

•Contacts can now be switched to a floating window.

•Improves the search experience in the Documents app.

•Apps in large folders can now be displayed in 3 × 3 grids.

•Improves system stability and performance.

•Extends battery life in some scenarios.

•Fixes an issue that might cause some apps to crash.

•Fixes an issue where the captions of AI Voice cannot be closed after WeChat voice calls are ended.

•Fixes a display issue where some app icons might overlap with other elements when pulling down the Quick Settings in the Photos app after restarting the phone.

•Integrates the November 2024 Android security patch to enhance system security.

Please do not turn off your device while the update is installing. During Installation you cannot use your device at all, even to dial 9-1-1
